caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) of two models—Transformer and MoHD—across varying numbers of sub-dimensions, ranging from 64 to 256 on a logarithmic x-axis scale, with tick marks at 64, 128, and 256 (note that 1632 appears to be a typographical error and likely should be 16 or 32, but is plotted as labeled). The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL,” spans from 9.5 to 12.5 in linear scale with major gridlines at intervals of 0.5. The Transformer model is represented by a red dashed line with no markers, maintaining a nearly constant Eval PPL of approximately 11.65 across all sub-dim settings. The MoHD model is depicted by a blue solid line with circular markers, starting at an Eval PPL of about 10.45 at 64 sub-dims, rising slightly to 10.65 at 128, and then stabilizing near 10.6 at 256. A light blue shaded region highlights the performance range of MoHD, visually emphasizing its consistently lower perplexity compared to Transformer across all tested sub-dim configurations.
